title: Fix Flaky Elements Surface Chrome Release Clear Test
description: Fix flaky ElementsSurfaceChrome test 'applies every driver axis attribute and clears them on release' by awaiting a real animation frame after calling release().
summary: Fixed the flaky ElementsSurfaceChrome test 'applies every driver axis attribute and clears them on release' in 🧰️framework/🔨️module/🖱️ui/⚛️react/⚡️implementation/🟦️typescript/📦️index.tsx. Updated the test to be async and await a requestAnimationFrame callback after release() so that scheduleElementsSurfaceChromeDeferredClear's rAF callback runs before dataset assertions.
